violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. When instructed the employee to wash hands during inspection, the employee rinsed the hands at the 3-vat sink. When instructed the employee to wash hands at the hand washing sink, the employee washed hands very quickly and turn off the faucet with washed hands before getting paper towel.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. DISCUSSED WITH THE MANAGER TO TRAIN EMPLOYEES ON PROPER HAND WASHING PROCEDURES..

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at bar handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. Advised the operator to provide hand washing soap at the bar hand sink during inspection.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Marinated raw chicken, raw goat and raw fish items were stored above cooked and uncooked vegetable items inside the 3-dr prep refrigerator (R) at the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. INSTRUCTED THE OPERATOR TO REARRANGE THE FOOD ITEMS CONTAINERS TO KEEP THE RAW ANIMAL PRODUCTS ON THE BOTTOM SHELF DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Fried Paneer (48F), Vegetable base sauce (46F), Tomato Base Sauce (48F) in 3-dr prep refrigerator (L) at the cookline and Dairy Base Dessert (67F) at the 1-Dr Upright Display Refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. THE OPERATOR VOLUNTARILY DISCARDED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): - Biryani at the counter top - fried eggs at the counter top at the biryani station - boiled eggs at the counter top at the biryani station - Raita (yogurt sauce) at the expo at the cookline for take out
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. THE OPERATOR LABELED ALL THE FOOD ITEMS MENTIONED ABOVE WITH TIME (4 HOURS). NAVARASA BY BYRIANI GRILL (Inspection Date: 10/13/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: RAW CHICKEN WAS OBSERVED THAWING IN STANDING WATER THE DISH WASHING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO KEEP THE THAWING RAW CHICKEN UNDER RUNNING WATER AT THE 3-VAT SINK. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO TRAIN EMPLOYEES ON PROPER THAWING METHODS.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: 1) clear bottles with liquid (food coloring, soy sauce, oil) at the cook line. 2) white salt/sugar like substance at the spice tray at the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. THE OPERATOR LABELED ALL THE BOTTLED AND THE ITEM FROM THE SPICE TRAY.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Observed the back exit door is kept open for ventilation does not have effective door sweep to keep potential pest entry.
violations.corrective_action: Windows or doors kept open for ventilation or other purposes shall have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents by 1) 16 mesh to 25.4mm (16 mesh to 1 inch) screens; 2) properly designed and installed air curtains to control flying insects; or 3) other effective means. THE OPERATOR KEPT THE MAIN EXIT DOOR CLOSED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor at the dry storage area near hot water heater and inside the walk-in refrigerator units.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO MOVE ALL THE FOOD ITEMS AT THE DRY STORAGE AND WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR UNIT FLOOR TO SHELVING UNITS OR 6 INCH OFF THE FLOOR. NAVARASA BY BYRIANI GRILL (Inspection Date: 10/13/2026) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Ice cream scoop was stored in standing water at room temperature.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. THE OPERATOR REMOVED THE ICE SCOOP FROM WATER AND CLEANED AND SANITIZED BEFORE PLACING IT IN CLEAN CONTAINER.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Hotel pans, containers, other food contact items at the dish washing area were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO REMOVE ALL THE ITEMS THAT WERE WET NESTING TO AIR DRY BEFORE STACKING THEM. ALSO ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO TRAIN DISH WASHING EMPLOYEES AIR DRY BEOFRE STACKING THEM.

violations.title: Handled Utensils Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped knives, forks, or spoons were not stored with handles up at the dining service area and kitchen service area.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided. PROVIDED INSTRUCTIONS TO THE OPERATOR TO INVERT THE UTENSILS TO KEEP THE HANDLE UP DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) 1-Dr Upright Refrigerator near dish washing area - 67F 2) 3-Dr Prep Refrigerator (L) at cookline - 58F
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE PROVIDE SERVICE RECEIPTS FOR BOTH REFRIGERATOR UNITS WITHIN 7 DAYS.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: Toilet room door is not provided with a self-closing door.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door. ADVISED THE OPERATOR TO INTALL SELF-CLOSING DEVICE AT BOTH RESTROOM DOORS. THIS ITEM WILL BE VERIFIED DURING NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
